headline: Critical patching is below the amber line, with the illustrative gap concentrated in Equities Technology.

summary.disclaimer: Deterministic illustrative summary. Not a Snowflake Cortex response. Not connected to SMARTS.
summary.text: Critical Patch Compliance is the percentage of in-scope critical assets with required critical patches applied within the control window (provisional definition, pending validation). The illustrative reading is 90.4% as of 27 October 2026. Green is 98% and amber is 95%; higher is better. The result is red because 90.4% is below 95%. The supplied scenario states that the metric went red on 14 October. For CTL-VM-01, critical-asset patching is below the control’s amber threshold. Owner function on the illustrative register is Technology Risk.

whatChanged: The illustrative series is 90.4% on 27 October, below the 95% amber threshold. The supplied scenario states the metric went red on 14 October. Earlier points on the chart are illustrative.
whyItMatters: CTL-VM-01 expects critical assets to stay at or above 98% (green) and treats a fall through 95% as red. A reading of 90.4% means the control is outside its amber limit. The illustrative gap is concentrated in Equities Technology.
timelineNote: Dated readings on this page are illustrative synthetic values. The red breach on 14 October and the two related signals are supplied scenario facts. Signal dates were not supplied.
